issues: The three 420×250 dark cards had 14–19px titles and 12px captions in a mostly empty black frame, so you could not tell what the pipeline did
The two orbs were faint indigo-grey smudges and the surge on the landing frame barely registered, so the key same-frame resonance went unseen
A triangle of cards joined by thin lines read as a diagram, not a relay
There was no closing message; after f98 the frame just sat half-lit
changes: Midnight look (deep navy, electric blue, cyan): the cards became three 240px glass nodes of a voice-AI workflow 'Listen → Understand → Act' (product: Tessel) set high in the middle and lower at the sides, so the lines read as relay hops; 52px labels, 32px captions

Each node has a 720–820px orb behind it (electric blue, cyan, violet-blue) and the node drifts only 22% as far for parallax; the landing frame, the node's light-up frame and the orb's surge start share one constant: the orb rises to 1+1.6x brightness and 12% larger over 5f and fades over 15f while the node pulses its rim and throws a shock ring on the same frame
Lines have a white core with two cyan-blue glow layers and a leading comet head; growth winds up and brakes into the station; 4f after arrival the line dissolves over 14f into a fine dotted path

Close: after C lights, a 72px headline 'Say it once. Tessel does the rest.' rises word by word; orbs ease out with a sine over 110–140f and freeze for the last 25f; the camera pushes 1 to 1.04 while its focus follows the relay from A to C
